# Power of Appointment

A testamentary power granting someone the authority to decide how assets or trust interests are distributed. Common in complex wills — the testator grants discretion to an appointee (typically an executor or trustee) to allocate among a defined class of beneficiaries

Source: [`v3/power-of-appointment.json`](../../v3/power-of-appointment.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/power-of-appointment.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Unique identifier for this power of appointment |
| `appointorPersonId` | `string` (uuid) | yes | The person granting the power (usually the testator) |
| `appointorPersonIdDisplay` | `string` | | Human-readable display name for the appointor |
| `appointeePersonId` | `string` (uuid) | yes | The person who holds the power and may exercise it (e.g. executor, trustee, spouse) |
| `appointeePersonIdDisplay` | `string` | | Human-readable display name for the appointee |
| `powerType` | one of `general`, `special`, `hybrid` | yes | Whether this is a general, special, or hybrid power of appointment |
| `classOfBeneficiaries` | `string` | | Natural-language definition of who the appointee may appoint to. Required for special and hybrid powers |
| `scope` | `object` | | Which assets, trusts, or bequests this power covers. If absent, the power applies to the entire residuary estate |
| `exerciseConditions` | `string` | | Conditions or limitations on how the power may be exercised |
| `exercisedDate` | `string` (date) | | Date the power was exercised, if it has been |
| `exercisedDocumentId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to the Document.id recording the exercise of this power |
| `notes` | `string` | | Free-text notes about this power of appointment |
| `provenance` | [Provenance](common/provenance.md) | | Consolidated provenance metadata |

Also accepts properties whose names match `^x-inherit-[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,54}$`.
